item.title: What the equinox 'henge' effect tells us about U.S. cities
item.description: The fall equinox, which arrives Tuesday in the U.S., brings shorter days, and chances to witness alignment between Earth and the sun. It's a modern version of ancient observances of a celestial shift.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Aviation regulators turn to AI to help manage the nation's airspace
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration launched an ambitious $875-million-dollar push to make the U.S. airspace more efficient. But critics say it won't solve bigger problems with air traffic control.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: The data center backlash is reshaping American politics — one community at a time
item.description: With striking speed, the widespread debate around data centers has become a fault line in American communities, cutting across political parties and forging unexpected alliances.

item.title: Diesel -- the fuel the U.S. economy runs on -- hits record high
item.description: Diesel prices continue setting records, now above $6.50 a gallon. That could mean higher prices not just for truckers, but for everyone.

item.title: How a national farm leader is dealing with record diesel prices
item.description: John Boyd Jr., president of the National Black Farmers Association, says soaring diesel costs are deepening a farm crisis as farmers face sharply higher fuel costs in the middle of harvest season.
